title: Decision Transformer: Reinforcement Learning via Sequence Modeling
description: Offline RL as conditional sequence modeling. Return-conditioned autoregressive policy using GPT. No Bellman equations, no bootstrapping — just sequence modeling. Bridged RL and LLMs.
authors: Chen, Lu, Rajeswaran, Lee, Grover, Laskin, Abbeel, Srinivas, Mordatch
